'''AL-82673''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Processing Plant]]. It was set up in line with [[Asteroid Mining Unit]] [[XP-MU 3376]] in the [[Asteroid field/Legends|asteroid field]] near [[Kessel/Legends|Kessel]].
